name: io.github.8itlab/reflex-computer-use
title: reflex-computer-use
description: Computer use for AI agents: drive macOS and Windows desktops via the UI tree, Jev as a fast judge.

environmentVariables.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your TypeSafe key for the Jev tools (find, check, wait). Optional; OPENROUTER_API_KEY or COMMANDCODE_API_KEY also work.

environmentVariables.name: CU_SSH
environmentVariables.description: SSH alias of a remote Windows machine to control instead of this one (needs the daemon installed there).
